name: 목판화
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Redraw this SAME character, exact body/head ratios, right-facing front3/4 combat-ready stance, all joint positions and both weapon angles. This image is the edit target; do not redesign costume or anatomy.
Create an EXTREME BLACK AND WHITE WOODCUT: ONLY opaque black ink and opaque white reserves with transparent outside. REMOVE EVERY yellow/gold/blue/brown/peach hue, even from hair, skin, scarf and sword inlays. Translate them into black/white print. Hair still same spiky shape, face same age/features; NO colored accents anywhere.
Differentiate sharply from brush ink and manga: broad heavy BLACK silhouette blocks with exceptionally thick straight/angular WHITE KNIFE GOUGES, large triangular chisel-cut channels and rough serrated carved edges. At least70% of costume mass is solid ink black; white channels cut across it. No little bristle strokes, no swooping brushmarks, no fine hatching or dots. Woodblock carving with deliberate very coarse cuts readable at thumbnail size, not a monochrome anime cel filter.
Right hand one longsword points up-right in front; left hand one short angular dagger near chest; preserve ring/wing guard, crescent right pauldron, right plated shin and left cloth boot as coarse cut motifs. Keep A large-head short-limb SD proportions. All hair, boot soles, blades inside with at least5% clear transparent margins; one isolated full-body character only, no background, panels, paper rectangle, text or extra props. Preserve pose and outfit while entirely translating marks into this extremely coarse monochrome carved medium.
